sources.title: Libyan News Agency: national E-VISA LIBYA platform activation
sources.officialityEvidence: The state Libyan News Agency reports the 29 June 2026 Government circular that activates E-VISA LIBYA as the approved national platform for electronic visas and foreigner entry and residence management.
sources.supportingExcerpt: E-VISA LIBYA ... the approved national platform for managing electronic visas.

sources.title: E-VISA LIBYA: live regular-passport and electronic-visa resource
sources.officialityEvidence: The public live resource backing evisa.gov.ly identifies Regular as a passport type and Electronic Visa as an available visa type; the Government circular identifies E-VISA LIBYA as the approved national platform.

sources.title: E-VISA LIBYA: current public country configuration
sources.officialityEvidence: The live public national-platform configuration explicitly provides country codes together with availability, exemption type, online-application availability and visa-delivery type. It is used here only for codes it positively lists as active.

sources.title: E-VISA LIBYA: current purpose-of-visit options
sources.officialityEvidence: The live public E-VISA LIBYA application resource includes tourism and visit among its current purpose-of-visit options, tying the live electronic route to ordinary short-visitor use.

sources.title: Justice Ministry: Law No. 6 of 1987 on entry, residence and exit of foreigners
sources.officialityEvidence: Libya's Ministry of Justice currently publishes the full text of Law No. 6 of 1987. It retains a valid-visa baseline while separately preserving Arab-national identity-card entry and agreement or special-authorisation exceptions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A foreigner may enter ... if holding a valid visa.

policies.title: Libya: active ordinary-passport electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: E-VISA LIBYA's current active country configuration positively lists these ordinary-passport nationalities with no exemption, online application and EMAIL visa delivery; the same national portal makes Electronic Visa available and includes tourism and visit purposes.
conditions: The live country configuration expressly marks each listed code as active, not exempt, online-applicable and EMAIL-delivered. It is a current electronic issuance route rather than a visa-on-arrival or mere online preapproval.

Use a regular ordinary passport and select a current visitor purpose (tourism or visit) in E-VISA LIBYA. The portal's nationality, date-of-birth and gender checker, supporting-document requirements, payment, carrier rules and final border admission still apply.

application.label: E-VISA LIBYA public nationality eligibility checker
steps: Choose the regular-passport nationality, gender and date of birth in the official eligibility checker.
If the official checker permits the route, create the electronic-visa application and select tourism or visit as appropriate.
Complete the portal's document, payment and any review requirements; travel only after the visa has been issued and delivered by the service.

policies.title: Libya: current full ordinary-passport visitor exemption
policies.summary: E-VISA LIBYA's current active country configuration explicitly marks these ordinary-passport nationalities with FULL exemption rather than an electronic-visa requirement.
conditions: This is limited to the ordinary short-visitor setting represented by the live national eligibility configuration. It does not establish treatment for diplomatic or service passports, residence, work, group travel, or other special cases.
Passport validity, the live eligibility check, carrier requirements and final border admission remain separate.
